title: Dallas right-of-way permit
source_agency: City of Dallas Public Works Department

permits.name: Right-of-Way Permit

explanations.trigger_explanation: Construction that cuts, breaks, or otherwise damages Dallas public right-of-way likely needs a right-of-way permit.

advisories: Technical standards and pavement-repair conditions may add project-specific obligations.
notes: Tier 2: official city right-of-way management guidance clearly states the permit requirement, but project-specific conditions can vary.
